## About me!

I am a senior Statistics and Data Science major on the pre-dental track. I am from Houston, TX but grew up in New Orleans, LA. I have a little brother named Max, a cat named Claude, and a dog named Gumbo. In my free time I like to go to the gym, read (sometimes), listen to music, and eat out with my friends.
